_readme: Landmarks drawn on the artwork that have no GPS behind them. Finding one captures the finder's coordinates, which is how the map gets more accurate. Add a row and it appears in the Hunt tab; ids must stay stable because found records are keyed to them. 'hint' is what to look for, not where it is -- that is the point.

quests.name: The Owl
quests.hint: Number 37 in the legend. You'll know it when you see it.

quests.name: Rocketship
quests.hint: Pointed at the sky somewhere in the valley.

quests.name: Art Gallery
quests.hint: Framed work, out among the trees.

quests.name: Star No. 9
quests.hint: Marked on the map between the campgrounds.

quests.name: Cave 560
quests.hint: A cave mouth with a number on it.

quests.name: A Renegade Stage
quests.hint: Unofficial, unannounced, moves around. Any one counts.

quests.name: Medical
quests.hint: Red cross. Worth knowing before you need it.

quests.name: Golf Cart Pickup
quests.hint: The ride for when the hill wins.

quests.name: Parking
quests.hint: There is more than one. Any counts.

quests.name: Hyper Boys Hole
quests.hint: Named on the map up near Stargazer.

quests.name: Merchandise
quests.hint: The shirt you'll regret not buying.

quests.name: A Food Vendor
quests.hint: Any one counts. Pick a good one.
